chapter: British revival and the Crane River band
title: Adapting British folk and pop tunes to jazz
summary: The Crane River band played 'The Miner's Dream of Home' and 'Bobby Shafto', for which Colyer claims the break arrangement; other pop tunes were easily adapted.
